card.name: Inside ALL-CAPS headings
card.fires_on: Words in ALL-CAPS section headings or titles, often partway through a word or on a small linking word. Typical cases are RESPIR|ATORY in a warning heading, OF in a department name, and FREE in a numbered heading.

modes.label: Capitalized medical heading
modes.description: The ending of a long capitalized word in a warning heading, as in RESPIR-ATORY before DEPRESSION.
modes.example: WARNING: ADDICTION, ABUSE, AND MISUSE; LIFE-THREATENING RESPIR<<ATORY>> DEPRESSION; ACCIDENTAL INGEST

modes.label: Capitalized title or list heading
modes.description: Small linking words or numbering marks, or the first word, in an all-caps title or numbered heading.
modes.example: CONNECTICUT DEPARTMENT<< OF>> ENERGY AND ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION AND

card.plain: It fires on words inside headings written entirely in capital letters.
